name: ElizaOS
description: Open-source multi-agent framework built for social and character-based AI agents. Designed for agents with persistent personas, memory, and social platform integrations (Twitter/X, Discord, Telegram, Farcaster). Popular in the crypto-native AI agent community. Emerging trust state — high hype velocity, rapid changes, real production usage in social trading agents.

ecosystem_fit.notes: ElizaOS originated in the Solana ecosystem and is most used for Solana-native social trading agents and character-based bots.
Can integrate with Base but is more EVM-agnostic. Less native than in the Solana ecosystem.
Farcaster plugin available for ElizaOS character agents posting to Farcaster.

common_pairings.context: Helius for Solana onchain event detection; ElizaOS for character-based agent reasoning and social response generation.
ElizaOS has its own execution loop; Trigger.dev is the orchestration alternative when production durability is required over ElizaOS's native loop.

trust_evidence.description: High adoption in the crypto-native AI agent community, particularly for social trading agents. Significant GitHub stars and active development. But rapid release cadence introduces breaking changes.
ElizaOS received significant crypto-community attention in late 2024 / early 2025. Hype velocity is high — verify current stability before production adoption.

scale_guidance.hackathon: Valid for hackathons where the demo benefits from a character-based AI persona. Quick setup for social agent demos.
scale_guidance.mvp: Viable if the persona/character aspect is a core product differentiator. Verify stability of your required plugins before committing.
scale_guidance.production: Not recommended for production-critical agents due to experimental trust state and rapid breaking changes. Use Vercel AI SDK or LangChain for production agents, ElizaOS for persona overlay if needed.

alternatives.when_to_prefer: Production agents where stability and portability matter more than character personas. Vercel AI SDK has production-grade trust state and stable API surface.
Complex multi-step reasoning chains, memory management, and RAG pipelines where ElizaOS's character focus is not needed.

anti_patterns: Using ElizaOS for production financial agents — experimental trust state means breaking changes are likely. Financial agents require stability guarantees ElizaOS cannot currently provide.
Assuming ElizaOS plugin ecosystem is stable — plugins vary widely in quality and maintenance. Audit each plugin before production use.
Using ElizaOS on EVM chains expecting the same depth as Solana — EVM plugins are less mature than Solana integrations.

sdk_migration.note: ElizaOS package names have changed from @ai16z/eliza to @elizaos/* scope. Check current package names before installing.
